Evidence labels

Confirmed record
A direct chain response, transaction, contract state, source-code line or dated primary document. A successful action proves use of authority, not exclusive key custody.
Derived analysis
Arithmetic, grouping or comparison of cited records. The full-hub-YES outcome and combined vAMP shares are scenarios, not observed events.
Interpretation
A relationship or pattern that justifies a question. Timing, payments, shared protocols and NFT collections alone do not establish ownership, coordination or motive.
Unresolved
Missing off-chain agreements, classification, historical membership or notification evidence. A search of these records cannot establish that no other evidence exists.

Original records behind the supplied website

The initial packet came from 0xphilipp-payments.pages.dev. Its source index and embedded locators were used to identify original chain, forum and GitHub records where possible. Preserved source copies remain under /record/; their original commentary is not adopted as this review’s conclusion.

  • The compiled A1–A289 record retains per-proposal ballot query URLs, transaction hashes and source hashes.
  • The packaged authority ledger retains operation-level transaction locators. The original handover lines and current roles were checked separately.
  • Every retained data artifact has a sibling .source.md describing immediate source, upstream source where established, transformation and SHA-256.
  • The supplied uncorroborated spreadsheet is not published or used as an attribution source.
  • Audit repository and provenance register
  • Phoenix Directive original governance documents
  • ERIS contracts and voting source
  • Phoenix governance forum
  • Phoenix project website

Scope and limitations

  • Historical governance review cutoff: 26 October 2026; native tally and scenario refreshed 27 October, approximately 15:07 UTC. Proposal 4853 remains open until 31 October at 03:40 UTC.
  • Source independence: the earlier HighStakes LCD is operated by a reviewed validator with an ABSTAIN ballot and approximately 3.254M LUNA of hub delegation. The 27 October refresh uses tdrsys; sequential queries do not establish a common block height. Hub and ICS20 configuration were exactly cross-checked against tdrsys.
  • Smart Stake validator-total weights are secondary analytics. Primary native ballots contain options, not per-ballot LUNA weights.
  • Not every packaged historical operation was independently replayed; that limitation is stated wherever the ledger is used.
  • Some providers omit older records or do not index all transactions. An empty search result cannot establish that an action never occurred.
  • Payment coverage and historical valuation vary by category. Gross flows are not net worth, profit or loss.
  • No identity research, surname-based searches or personal-contact calls are part of this review.

Corrections and responses

Corrections should identify the page, statement and supporting source. Responses and corrections should appear beside the affected claim.

27 October transaction supplement

48 successful primary transaction records, with explicit limits on what each proves.

For all 38 Terra transactions, SHA-256 recomputed from the original encoded transaction bytes matches the cited hash; RPC height and execution code also match the LCD response. The archive endpoints may share infrastructure. This is a byte/hash and execution consistency check, not independent consensus or inclusion-proof verification.

The supplement contains 466 transfer rows, eight funded voting locks, seven redelegations and 23 findings with stated verification limits. Native transfers, CW20 and ERC20 movements retain their units. Fee-share events annotate bank transfers rather than adding the same receipt again; eight empty-amount transfer events remain explicitly unquantified.
